subject: alchemist_berserk_potion
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
evidence: 炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

context.description_en: Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh: 炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。驱散类型：弱驱散

subject: alchemist_chemical_rage
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
炼金术士诱发他的食人魔同伴进入化学狂暴，降低攻击间隔，提高移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Has a %transformation_time% second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.
notes_zh: 拥有%transformation_time%秒的变身时间，可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道以及眩晕技能。

subject: black_king_bar
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

abilities.title: Avatar
abilities.description:
Applies a basic dispel. Grants 60% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect. 

Duration: 9s 
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

context.notes:
Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration.
Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.

subject: chaos_knight_phantasm
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
从其他维度召唤若干个混沌骑士的幻象。幻象继承%outgoing_damage_tooltip%%%攻击力，但是承受%incoming_damage_tooltip%%%伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
notes_zh: 能够移除混沌骑士的大部分负面状态。
混沌骑士在施放时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以躲避眩晕和伤害技能。

scepter_loc.en: Gains a passive component.  When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
scepter_loc.zh: 增加被动效果。混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有%bonus_illusion_chance%%%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。

subject: disperser
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

abilities.title: Suppress
abilities.description:
Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 4 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 4 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

abilities.title: Manabreak
abilities.description:
Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.

subject: enchantress_enchant
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续%slow_duration%秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续%dominate_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Illusions can be converted.
notes_zh: 可以转化幻象。

scepter_loc.en: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
scepter_loc.zh: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。

subject: huskar_berserkers_blood
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
context.description_zh: 哈斯卡的伤痛赐予他力量，根据他损失的生命值将获得攻击速度、魔法抗性和生命恢复加成。生命恢复为力量的一定百分比。
notes_en: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
notes_zh: 加成效果为线性增加，满血时没有加成，%hp_threshold_max%%%生命时达到最大加成。

shard_loc.en: Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh:
哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散

subject: huskar_life_break
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.
notes_zh: 如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。

scepter_loc.en: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
scepter_loc.zh: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。

subject: kez_raptor_dance
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
evidence: 凯进入不可控制的状态，持续%AbilityCastPoint%秒，%invuln_period%秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

context.description_en: Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
context.description_zh: 凯进入不可控制的状态，持续%AbilityCastPoint%秒，%invuln_period%秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。
notes_en: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.
notes_zh: 斩击非英雄单位或幻象时吸血量减少至%illusion_lifesteal_pct%%%。

subject: kez_ravens_veil
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
evidence: 凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。
Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

context.description_en: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
context.description_zh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。

subject: largo_catchy_lick
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
evidence: 朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

context.description_en:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Can lick runes to pull them.
notes_zh: 可以舔舐神符，将其牵引。

subject: life_stealer_rage
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
进入狂暴状态，变成减益免疫，提升魔法抗性和移动速度。

驱散类型：弱驱散

subject: lone_druid_savage_roar
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
evidence: 施加弱驱散效果，并对施法者附近范围内友军提供移动速度和攻击速度加成。
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed.

context.description_en: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
context.description_zh: 独行德鲁伊和熊灵发出野性的咆哮，使周围敌人恐惧，朝自己的基地狂奔。敌人的移动速度将增加%bonus_speed%%%。
notes_en: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.
notes_zh: 被缠绕的英雄将无法移动。
与熊灵共享冷却时间。

shard_loc.en: Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh: 施加弱驱散效果，并对施法者附近范围内友军提供移动速度和攻击速度加成。施法效果会在独行德鲁伊和熊灵之间复制，不论双方是否可以施法。驱散类型：弱驱散

subject: manta
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

abilities.title: Mirror Image
abilities.description:
Creates 2 images of your hero that last 18 seconds. 

Melee images deal 33% damage, while Ranged images deal 25%. Illusions take 300% damage. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

context.notes:
Has a 0.1 second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

subject: marci_unleash
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
evidence: 怒拳破的冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction%秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。
Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci.

context.description_en:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
context.description_zh:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续%pulse_debuff_duration%秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续%time_between_flurries%秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升%bonus_movespeed%%%。
notes_en: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.
notes_zh: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。
移除攻击速度限制。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 怒拳破的冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction%秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续%pulse_silence_duration%秒。驱散类型：弱驱散

subject: naga_siren_mirror_image
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
制造多个受娜迦海妖控制的镜像。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.
notes_zh: 娜迦海妖在施法时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以用来躲避眩晕和伤害。
施放后，将会移除娜迦海妖身上大部分效果。
施放时现有的镜像幻象将被摧毁。

subject: oracle_fortunes_end
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
持续施法 - 将神谕者的力量汇聚为一股蕴含荡涤之力的能量，对敌方目标释放这股能量可以对其造成伤害，使其被缠绕，并且驱散其附近区域的魔法效果。如果目标是友军，将只造成驱散效果。缠绕时间随着持续施法时间逐渐提升。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Affects invulnerable units.
notes_zh: 可以作用无敌单位。

subject: pangolier_gyroshell
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
notes_zh: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

subject: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过%delay%秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受%illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少%illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
notes_zh: 这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。

subject: satanic
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

abilities.title: Unholy Rage
abilities.description:
Increases Lifesteal percentage to 175% for 6 seconds. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

abilities.title: Lifesteal
abilities.description: Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

subject: shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en: Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration.  At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh: 净愈目标友方单位，在持续时间内移除负面效果。在持续时间结束时该单位受到治疗效果。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净愈的效果。驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.
notes_zh: 净愈的持续时间内将持续移除目标的负面状态。

subject: shadow_demon_demonic_purge
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.
notes_zh: 减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 邪恶净化具有破坏效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

subject: sven_storm_bolt
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
evidence: 提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。
Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target.

context.description_en: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
context.description_zh: 斯温用他充满魔力的手套对目标周围内所有敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成%scepter_bonus_damage%点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。

subject: techies_reactive_tazer
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
evidence: 攻击目标的敌人会受到伤害被暂时缴械，并且受到弱驱散效果。
Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

context.description_en: Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
context.description_zh: 工程师对友军目标放出电荷，使他们短时间内获得移动速度加成。攻击目标的敌人会受到伤害被暂时缴械，并且受到弱驱散效果。效果结束时，或者用子技能提前引爆后电荷将会爆炸，使范围内所有敌人缴械并受到伤害。

subject: troll_warlord_battle_trance
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

context.description_en:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击%range%距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血，攻击速度，减速抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.
notes_zh: 巨魔战将在战斗专注作用下仍然可以使用他的物品技能，但是无法执行其他指令。
斧王的淘汰之刃还是能斩杀巨魔战将。
巨魔战将会获得目标的视野。

subject: wind_waker
definition: 移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果

abilities.title: Cyclone
abilities.description:
Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for 2.5 seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of 300.

Enemy units take 50 magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

context.notes:
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

subject: doom_bringer_doom
definition: 使目标的被动技能暂时失效
evidence: 末日对敌人施加破坏效果。

context.description_en:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
对敌人施加末日诅咒，对其进行驱散，并且使其无法施放技能或获得任何治疗效果，同时造成持续伤害。

驱散类型：弱驱散

scepter_loc.en: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
scepter_loc.zh: 末日对敌人施加破坏效果。末日作用下目标%scepter_aura_radius%范围内友军也会受到末日的作用。可以对自身施放末日，使末日作用于末日使者周围的敌人。

subject: hoodwink_sharpshooter
definition: 使目标的被动技能暂时失效
evidence: 森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加破坏和减速效果。

context.description_en:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
context.description_zh:
森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加破坏和减速效果。伤害和负面状态持续时间随着装载时间增加，%max_charge_time%秒后达到最大效果，弩箭在%misfire_time%秒后自动发射。
由于弩箭的威力，森海飞霞后退%recoil_distance%距离。弩箭穿过的非英雄单位会受到半额伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升箭矢速度和减速效果。

subject: primal_beast_uproar
definition: 使目标的被动技能暂时失效
evidence: 弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。

context.description_en:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
context.description_zh:
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过%damage_limit%点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。

主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续%roar_duration%秒。
notes_en: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes_zh: 獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。

scepter_loc.en: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
scepter_loc.zh: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出%projectile_waves%波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有%projectiles_per_stack%个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

subject: shadow_demon_demonic_purge
definition: 使目标的被动技能暂时失效
evidence: 邪恶净化具有破坏效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

context.description_en:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.
notes_zh: 减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 邪恶净化具有破坏效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。
